analysis.headline: Shares Your Data With Ad Platforms
analysis.quote: Targeting and advertising cookies. These third-party cookies are placed by third-party advertising platforms or networks to deliver ads and track ad performance. In some cases, these cookies enable advertising networks to deliver ads that may be relevant to you based upon your activities on our website and other websites (in such cases, ad serving might be based on automated decision-making).

analysis.headline: Shares Your Data With Partners
analysis.quote: We work with TUNE Inc. (“HasOffers”). This service uses cookies and pixel tags to determine when affiliates/ partner websites refer new customers to Oxylabs.

analysis.headline: Shares Data With Service Providers
analysis.quote: We may engage third-party service providers to facilitate various aspects of our services, therefore we may provide some of your personal data to the following categories of recipients: payment service providers (to the extent that is necessary to process payments and manage financial transactions related to our services) such as Stripe, servers, IT infrastructure, marketing, customer support, data analytics, risk tool/assessment, legal service providers.

analysis.headline: Retains Your Data Up to 5 Years
analysis.quote: Oxylabs.io stores communication related personal data up to 5 years from our last contact with you.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Activity Across Sites
analysis.quote: Targeting and advertising cookies... enable advertising networks to deliver ads that may be relevant to you based upon your activities on our website and other websites (in such cases, ad serving might be based on automated decision-making).

analysis.headline: Links Your Activity Across Devices
analysis.quote: AID This cookie is used to link your activity across devices if you’ve previously signed in to your Google Account on another device.

analysis.headline: Records Your Interviews (Audio/Video)
analysis.quote: When conducting interviews with our clients the following personal data may be processed: audio recordings (voice recordings) of the interview, capturing spoken responses and feedback; video recordings of the person‘s image during the interview; name, surname, email address, telephone number, and any contact information provided by the client; feedback, opinions, insights, and experiences regarding our products.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Internationally
analysis.quote: Your personal information may be transferred to and maintained on computers located outside of your state, country or other governmental jurisdiction where the data protection laws may differ than those from your jurisdiction.

analysis.headline: Discloses Data to Law Enforcement
analysis.quote: We may disclose personal data to state, governmental, law enforcement institutions, courts, and regulatory authorities when legally required, such as to support investigations or respond to official requests, including subpoenas.

analysis.headline: Offers Your GDPR Rights
analysis.quote: With respect to your personal data you have the following additional rights granted by the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR): to get familiar with your personal data and how it is processed; to demand restricting the processing of your personal data...
